answer: Flat fees tax the honest and the fake alike, so forgery stayed cheap. A sybil tax fixes that: each new identity pays a non-refundable 90-unit tax, held 4 epochs, 15% back per honest epoch. It cannot be recycled: a zenith of fresh clones each pays full price. Forgery burns the rest and freezes it 8 epochs. A basalt wall of sunk cost blocks scale: 1,000 clones prepay 90,000, a 30% fraud rate burns 27,000; ivory-clean history earns it back.
